name: Bergjuwel
beschreibung: The Bergjuwel is a charming hotel located in Neustift im Stubaital, Tyrol, a premier destination for mountain holidays. The hotel offers comfortably equipped rooms and apartments across several categories to suit every need. A relaxing wellness area featuring a sauna and tranquil relaxation rooms invites guests to unwind after an active day outdoors. Summer offers scenic alpine hiking trails, while winter delivers premier skiing opportunities, including the nearby Stubai Glacier. The dining room serves a harmonious blend of regional and international cuisine, and the attentive staff is delighted to assist with planning local excursions.
